pages.text: Role: endgame melee finisher. Core loop: right-click opener -> basic-hit mark stacking -> execute pulse finish.
Crafted from Singularity progression drops plus high-tier realm materials.
$(l)Active: Annihilation Slash$(/l)$(br2)Right click releases a forward cone slash that deals heavy burst and knockback.
$(l)Passive: Mark Loop$(/l)$(br2)Basic hits stack marks. At max stacks, trigger an execute pulse around the target, with lethal effect on low-health enemies.
$(l)Tips$(/l)$(br2)$(li)Open fights with right-click burst$(li)Stay close to maintain stack uptime$(li)Detonate marks when enemies enter execute range
